item.title: CVE-2026-95614 · 9.3 CRITICAL — Zenitel Connect host applies rsyslog configuration written to a volume shared with the hiatus container
item.description: The host configuration watcher in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 applies a rsyslog configuration file written to a data volume that is shared with the hiatus application container, which allows local attackers with write access to the hiatus container…

item.title: CVE-2026-105623 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Zenitel Connect web interface serves production JavaScript source maps without authentication
item.description: The web interface in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 serves production JavaScript source maps without authentication, which allows remote attackers to obtain the complete front-end source code, including API usage and internal client logic, via request…

item.title: CVE-2026-105624 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Zenitel Connect login allows account-lockout denial of service
item.description: The login flow in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 applies per-account lockout on repeated failed login attempts, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (temporary lockout of targeted user accounts from the web interface, repeatable…

item.title: CVE-2026-105622 · 6.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Zenitel Connect missing lockout and rate limiting on the WAMP-CRA authentication channel
item.description: Improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts in the WAMP-CRA (challenge-response) authentication path in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 allows remote attackers to guess user passwords via unlimited authentication attempts, because the pat…

item.title: CVE-2026-105625 · 5.1 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Zenitel Connect web interface loads integration iframe without sandboxing or origin restriction
item.description: The web interface in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 loads an integration iframe without sandboxing or origin restrictions, which allows remote attackers to present phishing content to authenticated users via a crafted frame source.

item.title: CVE-2026-105671 · 6.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — Zenitel Connect login allows username enumeration via verbose error responses
item.description: The login flow in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 returns different error responses depending on whether a submitted username exists, which allows remote attackers to enumerate valid user accounts via crafted login requests.
